issues.on_page: Capital outlay (1,863,032), Water column, under Other Receipts (Disbursements)
issues.issue: The function is inferred from the fund column; the page prints no function, and the Statement of Activities (p2) shows Capital outlay as its own business-type line. The FY2022 ruling says to give a function only when it is printed. The governmental 'Capital outlay' in the same report was left generic, so the two are handled differently. The same applies to detail[37].

issues.on_page: Sales Tax 18,537 (Electric column); Statement of Activities p2 counts it in Electric charges for services 310,705
issues.issue: This is probably sales tax collected on electric bills, not the village's local option sales tax. 'sales tax' is defensible, but charges for services is possible. The same applies to detail[45].
